results.title: Saint-Etienne defender Ebenezer Annan emerges as Rapid 1923 transfer target
results.description: Ebenezer Annan, the 23-year-old Ghanaian left-back at Saint-Etienne, is being linked with a move to FC Rapid 1923 in Romania.The reported interest places Annan at the centre of a potential transfer between clubs competing in different divisions and countries. Saint-Etienne are in France’s Ligue 2, while Rapid 1923 play in Romania’s SuperLiga.Annan’s position is left-back, and the proposed move would represent a change of league for the Ghana international. The link was recorded on 17 August 2026, with Rapid 1923 identified as the club interested in taking him from Saint-Etienne.The defender’s current market value is €1.8m, a figure that provides an indication of his standing in the transfer market but does not represent a confirmed fee for the possible move. No probability has been attached to the rumour.Annan remains contracted to Saint-Etienne until 30 June 2028, meaning the French club retain him under a long-term agreement. Any move to Rapid 1923 would therefore involve a transfer away from his current contract rather than a free transfer.
